A name to begin with

This is a name-only directory outline. Detailed history, reading sources and community-specific imagery are queued. An identification check makes this name findable; it does not count as substantive research, an adequacy assessment or community endorsement.

Names & relationships

This government is named separately in the January 30, 2026 federal list. The BIA directory separately lists its administrative location in California. This identification does not establish a homeland, legal boundary, ethnic umbrella relationship, membership or community endorsement.
